title: Tale Of A Getaway Gal; Missing

contact_edits.before: There's a pervasive belligerence about the performances: especially Emma Hillier's as the farmer's eldest daughter, another of those sullen, sulky teenagers who are becoming a stage cliche, and Shauna Black's Elaine, opaque however you take her. Kyra Harper has the warmest and wittiest writing as Janine, though she gabbles some of it, and is probably too striking and eccentric a presence to be the point of balance the play seems to require. Guy Bannerman, though, makes a pleasing Freddy -- who, in the spirit of equality, makes a brief getaway of his own--and Andrew Gillies is excellently bewildered, resentful and furious, in that order, as the teacher without a pet. - Missing runs until April 5. Call 416-504-9971 or visit factorytheatre.ca for tickets and information.
